pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. All five lessons carry expanded_walkthrough blocks of 4000+ chars covering title/rationale/setup/teacher_script/expected_student_responses (4 bands)/common_misconceptions (3 each, paired with concrete recovery_moves). Lesson 1 includes the chant-the-fact-three-times move for transitioning from count-on to recall; Lesson 2 includes the swap-then-make-ten move for the order-dependence misconception; Lesson 3 includes the cup-hide game for transitioning from count-back to fact-family-recall; Lesson 4 includes the require-the-tape-diagram-before-the-equation move; Lesson 5 includes the pre-cut paper cookie move for the fair-share-with-half. Five distinct worksheet response_types: write, draw_or_write, circle_or_loop, match, self_rate. Mid-unit formative gate (Mid-Unit Strategy Check-In after Lesson 3) AND unit-level reflection sheet (5 prompts) both present.

instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA progression spans the whole week: concrete (real two-colour counters, real treats, paper cookies, real coins-as-counters) → representational (double ten-frame drawings, fact-family triangle diagrams, tape diagrams) → abstract (equations, fact-family notation, mental-strategy verbalisation). Lesson 2 'Doubles, Near-Doubles, Make-Ten' is the strategy keystone; Lesson 4 'Build It, Solve It' is the modelling capstone integrating B2.1-B2.4 in one play scenario; Lesson 5 closes with B2.5 + B2.4 reinforcement.

clarity_communication.justification: Strict L4 met. All five lessons have expanded_walkthrough blocks with substantial teacher_script (≥3000 chars dialogue), 4 expected_student_responses bands (Confused/Mid/Strong/Stretched), and 3 misconceptions paired with concrete recovery_moves. Every lesson has student_learning_goal starting with 'I can'. Teacher scripts use embodied gestures (the chant, the cup-hide reveal, the body-clap analogy for halves) so the script is enactable, not just readable. Child-voice 'I can' banners on every worksheet header.
